description: The plot illustrates the accuracy of two LLM variants—Llama4 Scout (represented by the top blue line) and Llama4 Maverick (represented by the bottom green line)—on 5-digit multiplication tasks, as a function of initial confidence, with an additional orange dashed line showing a third trend (possibly a baseline or alternative model). The x-axis, labeled “Initial Confidence,” ranges from 0.91 to 0.98 on a linear scale, with tick marks at 0.01 intervals. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy,” ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, also on a linear scale, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. The blue line (Llama4 Scout) starts at approximately 0.87 at 0.91 initial confidence, peaks near 1.0 at 0.92, and remains high (between 0.98 and 1.0) through 0.98. The green line (Llama4 Maverick) begins at ~0.22 at 0.91, dips to ~0.1 at 0.92, then steadily increases to ~0.9 at 0.98. The orange dashed line starts at ~0.65 at 0.91, rises to ~0.93 at 0.92, then declines steadily to ~0.15 at 0.98. All lines include error bars, indicating variability in measurements, with larger error bars visible on the orange and green lines at certain points.
